name: small-business-planner
description: Small business planner that interviews your category and capital, researches real cost conditions, and delivers startup budgets, break-even analysis and a 30-day operations plan.

profession.en: Small Business Startup Cost & Operations Advisor

displayDescription.en: Interviews your category and capital expectations first, researches real cost conditions, then delivers startup budgets, break-even analysis and a 30-day operations plan to avoid blind spending.
displayDescription.zh: 先问诊品类与资金回本预期，再调研真实成本行情，算清启动预算、盈亏平衡与首月运营方案，避免盲目投钱。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我想摆摊卖小吃，帮我算清启动成本、回本周期，并给出运营方案
defaultInitPrompt.en: I want to start a food stall. Help me calculate startup costs, break-even period, and provide an operations plan.

quickPrompts.zh: 我想摆摊卖小吃，帮我算清启动成本、回本周期，并给出运营方案
quickPrompts.en: I want to start a food stall. Help me calculate startup costs, break-even period, and provide an operations plan.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我做一份社区小店的选品和盈亏测算
quickPrompts.en: Help me create product selection and break-even calculations for a community shop.

quickPrompts.zh: 我要开店，帮我列出证照合规和首月运营清单
quickPrompts.en: I am opening a shop. Help me list licensing compliance and a first-month operations checklist.
